message.content:
An editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a centered portrait of a man wearing a dark cap and a dark suit with a white collar and a dark tie. The man’s face is rendered with detailed, visible brushstrokes in shades of peach, pink, and tan. He has short grey hair, thin lips, and a prominent nose. He looks slightly downward and to the right. The background behind him consists of swirling, textured brushstrokes in grey, white, and red.

At the top, large white block letters spell "TEMPO" against the background. Above this, smaller white text reads "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KEMERDEKAAN". Below "TEMPO," smaller text says "EDISI 20-26 AGUSTUS 2012". Across the center, cursive white text reads "Ernest Douwes Dekker." Below this, larger yellow block letters state "INSPIRASI BAGI REVOLUSI INDONESIA."

The left margin has a yellow vertical stripe with the words "TEMPO," "ERNEST DOUWES DEKKER," and "INSPIRASI BAGI REVOLUSI INDONESIA" in white and yellow. The bottom left includes a barcode, "RP 29.700," and other publishing details. The bottom right features a small rectangular inset with a gold circular object and the word "Award."
